_comment: Ground-truth checkpoints for tests/sources/test_astronomy.py. This source has no data/raw/ input -- these are the same cited published values normalise.py hard-codes as Checkpoints, kept here as an independent fixture so the test compares normalise()'s output against a committed reference rather than against its own source code. t is years BP; values in the series' unit (see manifest.toml).

day_length_hours.citation: Present mean solar day; 24 h by definition of the civil hour.
Williams, G.E. (2000), Reviews of Geophysics 38(1), 37-59 -- Elatina-Reynella tidal rhythmites, ~620 Ma.
Mitchell, R.N. & Kirscher, U. (2023), Nature Geoscience 16, 567-569 -- mid-Proterozoic stall, end (~1.0 Ga).
Mitchell & Kirscher (2023), as above -- stall start (~2.0 Ga).
Lantink, M.L. et al. (2022), PNAS 119(40), e2117146119 -- Joffre Member BIF cyclostratigraphy, 2.46 Ga.

moon_distance_km.citation: Present mean Earth-Moon distance (semi-major axis); IAU / lunar laser ranging.
Williams (2000), as above -- 58.16 +/- 0.30 Earth radii at 620 Ma.
Lantink et al. (2022), as above -- 321,800 +/- 6,500 km at 2.46 Ga.

solar_luminosity_rel.citation: Gough, D.O. (1981), Solar Physics 74, 21-34 -- L/L0 = 1 at t=0 by construction of the formula.
Gough (1981) formula evaluated at 4 Ga; commonly rounded to 'about 75% of present' in secondary literature.

Gough (1981) formula at t=EARTH_FORMATION (4.567e9, the domain's outer edge) -- just 3 Myr before t_sun=4.57e9 (the Sun's zero-age-main-sequence birth), so essentially the canonical 'faint young Sun' figure, L/L0 = 1/1.4 = 0.7143.

obliquity_deg.citation: Laskar, J. et al. (2004), A&A 428, 261-285 -- La2004 solution; long-term mean with the Milankovitch-cycle amplitude as bounds.
Laskar et al. (2004), as above -- held at the same mean across the solution's ~250 Myr domain; see README.md.
